details.title: Router: name the ceiling in fallback reasons
details.body:
## Name the ceiling in router fallback reasons

**Problem.** When the router falls back after a 404, the route event's reason does not say which ceiling applies, so neither the log nor an eval can show that a fallback stays at or below the role's ceiling.

**Change.** The 404 fallback reason now ends with `(ceiling stays <tier>)`. One line in `src/runtime/router.ts`; behaviour is unchanged.

**Check.** `pnpm eval --only router-fallback-404` failed before (`route_reason_contains "ceiling"`) and passes with this patch.
